payload.instruction: Move the mug to the right of the headphones
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Using the source-mug identity evidence, is the same mug to the right of the headphones, or is there clear evidence of movement toward that right-side relation without completion?
node.criteria: Pass only if the same source mug is reliably identified and is visibly to the right of the headphones. Fail only if the same mug is reliably identified and clear comparison shows no movement toward the right-side relation; report its source and edited positions. Unknown if identity or displacement cannot be resolved. Movement toward the right-side relation without reaching it is evidence of partial progress only when the same mug and that displacement are established; movement in another direction, a different mug on the right, or object presence alone is not progress.
node.binding: Use s1's specific identity/continuity observations, then compare the tracked mug's source and edited positions relative to the headphones. Explicitly report identity cues, displacement direction, and whether the right-side relation is achieved. Do not infer movement from the other mugs or the blue blur alone.
